digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and RUF rule family enablement
propositions: RUF rule family must be added to the global lint selection in pyproject.toml with RUF001, RUF002, and RUF003 permanently deferred as intentional Unicode prose/UI content
All 179 actionable RUF diagnostics across src/rebar and tests (measured via narrow census command) must be remediated before enabling RUF in the ratchet test
The ratchet test must assert exact deferral of RUF001–003 in ignore, absence of extend-ignore, and prohibit any RUF selector or code in per-file-ignores
Stale RUF100 suppressions introduced by full RUF rule set activation must be removed via Ruff's autofix, independent of the 771 narrow-selection RUF100 artifacts
After remediation, both narrow-census command and full linting suite must exit clean with no remaining RUF diagnostics except the three intentionally deferred codes
